Package com.userservice.app.controller

Class UserController

java.lang.Object
com.userservice.app.controller.UserController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/user") public class UserController extends Object
Controller for handling user-related operations, including user creation, updating user information, handling user surveys, and managing user location.
